title: Chicken Boti Kabab

ingredients.title: For the Marinade
items: Boneless chicken thighs – 700 g, cut into 1½-inch cubes
Roasted gram flour (besan) – 2 tbsp, lightly roasted

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Melted butter or ghee – as needed for brushing

instruction.title: Prepare the Chicken
steps: Wash the chicken pieces and pat them completely dry.
Cut the chicken thighs into approximately 1½-inch cubes.
Lightly prick each piece with a fork to help the marinade penetrate more deeply.

instruction.title: Roast the Gram Flour
steps: Place 2 tbsp gram flour in a dry pan over medium heat.
Roast until lightly golden and aromatic, stirring continuously to prevent burning.
Remove from heat and allow it to cool completely.

instruction.title: Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a large bowl, combine thick yogurt, fresh cream, ginger paste, garlic paste, green chili paste, lemon juice, mustard oil, and cooled roasted gram flour.
Add Kashmiri red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, black pepper, and salt.
Mix thoroughly until the marinade is smooth and evenly combined.
Add the chicken cubes and coat each piece thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
For deeper flavor and tenderness, marinate overnight.

instruction.title: Cook – Charcoal or BBQ
steps: Preheat the charcoal grill or BBQ to medium heat.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8–12 minutes, turning regularly.
Baste occasionally with melted butter or ghee.
Continue cooking until the chicken is cooked through and the edges are nicely charred.

instruction.title: Cook – Oven Method
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Arrange the chicken skewers on a rack positioned over a baking tray.
Bake for 15–18 minutes, turning once halfway through.
Switch to grill or broil mode for 2–3 minutes to develop charred edges.
Brush with melted butter or ghee before serving.

instruction.title: Cook – Tandoor Method
steps: Preheat the tandoor to approximately 300°C.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Cook until the chicken is tender, smoky, cooked through, and charred around the edges.
Turn the skewers as needed for even cooking.

instruction.title: Optional Smoky Finish
steps: Heat a small piece of charcoal until red-hot.
Place the cooked chicken in a heatproof tray with a small steel bowl inside.
Put the hot charcoal into the bowl and pour a little ghee over it.
Immediately cover tightly and allow the smoke to infuse for about 5 minutes.
Remove the charcoal before serving.

instruction.title: Finish & Serve
steps: Brush the hot chicken boti kababs with melted butter or ghee for extra shine and flavor.
Arrange on a serving platter with onion rings, lemon wedges, coriander, and mint leaves.
Serve immediately with green chutney.

chefTips: Chicken: Use boneless chicken thighs for juicy, tender boti kababs; breast meat can dry out more quickly.
Double marination: For deeper flavor, first marinate the chicken with lemon juice, chili, and salt for 20 minutes before adding the yogurt-spice marinade.
Besan: Lightly roasting the gram flour removes its raw flavor and adds a pleasant nutty aroma.
Smoky flavor: The dhungar method adds tandoori-style smokiness when cooking without charcoal.
Cooking: Avoid overcooking the chicken; boti kababs are best served immediately while hot and juicy.
Char: Finish over high heat briefly to develop flavorful charred edges without drying the center.
